title: Fooling with an aunt's little organ in Durham
summary: Whenever he finds a keyboard he sits down to play, an attraction he cannot explain.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I remember in Durham, I had an aunt who had...she also had a little organ type instrument. I don't know what it was called, but it had a keyboard. I used to go by, and by this time sit down and... I've forgot this little thing we used to play. It has a lot of different titles. But it was always a thing that you played in F-sharp, and I think what they called...Oh, what was it? I think they used to call it "Coonsshine(?) Baby" or something like that, "oom-bah, oom-bah, oom-bah-bah."

But every time I saw a keyboard, if I was allowed to, I would sit down and try to fool with it while the family was talking in another room, or the other kids were out playing. There just always seemed to be something about it that grabbed me. It was kind of like a toy, I guess. You can't explain these kind of things. As I look back now, I can see that there must have been something very deep down inside, some attraction there. But as to just what makes these things happen, you know, people have all sorts of things -- you're
born with this or that. But there's never an answer for these things.
